description: This file defines an ArxivTool class for searching and retrieving academic papers from Arxiv, including querying by keywords or IDs, parsing XML responses, and optionally downloading and extracting full PDF content.

classes.name: ArxivTool
classes.description: A class extending DynamicStructuredTool to perform searches on Arxiv, parse responses, and optionally download and extract full PDFs.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ArxivTool with optional parameters, logger, and organization ID.

methods.name: isArxivIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a query string matches the pattern of an Arxiv ID.

methods.name: parseArxivResponse
methods.description: Parses XML response from Arxiv API into a list of ArxivResult objects.

methods.name: extractXmlValue
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specific XML tag from a string.

methods.name: fetchResults
methods.description: Performs an API call to Arxiv to fetch search results based on the query.

methods.name: downloadAndExtractPdf
methods.description: Downloads a PDF from Arxiv and extracts its text content.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Main method to handle search queries, returning summaries or full content based on settings.
